emotional_core: The quiet relief of realising you weren't failing — you were just not yet at the moment where the advice could land.
visual_metaphor: A person reading an accurate map on the wrong stretch of road — the map is right, the terrain will match eventually, but only when they've walked far enough to reach it.
key_quotes: The gap between knowing advice and living it isn't closed by more knowing.
You're not behind because you keep hearing things you already knew. You're not failing because the advice hasn't stuck yet.
Advice is a pointer, not a shortcut.

story_frames.visual: Person at a laptop late at night, multiple browser tabs open — all self-improvement content. Expression is focused but nothing is being written or created. Screen glow on their face.
Tall stack of self-help books, spines visible with highlighter tabs sticking out. A loose bookmark slowly slides free and falls.
Same sentence written in a journal twice — once underlined faintly in pale ink (dated 2019), once circled urgently in dark ink (dated 2023). Same words, completely different energy.
story_frames.text: The advice didn't change. You did.

story_frames.visual: Person sitting in front of a blank document, cursor blinking. They open a new YouTube tab instead. The draft sits untouched behind it.
Hands holding a pen poised over a blank journal page — not yet moving. Beside it, a book lies open to a highlighted passage.
A winding path through a forest in early morning light. Fog in the distance. No destination visible. The path simply continues.
Same person from frame 1 — same desk, but now one tab open, something written on the page, expression quieter. Less frantic. More present.
